text: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. * 2. Scanned copy of valid passport information page (valid for at least 4 years). With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included * 3. Certificate of Non-criminal Record The content of the certificate must indicate the expiration date, or if there is no expiration date, the certificate should be valid for 6 months from the date of issue; Graduating students in China can submit a certificate of school performance. If you are unable to provide the Certificate of Non-criminal Record for the time being due to various special circumstances, please fill out theNo-criminal Commitment. You can download a template or sample from here . * 4. HSK level certificate * 5. Original scanned copy of the high school graduation certificate. Graduationcertificates obtained overseas shall be notarized, with scanned copies of the notarial certificates submitted. Recent graduates shall be issuedPre-graduation Certificate by their current school and shall, after being admitted, submit the originals of the graduation certificates and the scanned copies of the notarial certificates. * 6. Scanned copies of the original transcripts for all courses at high school or internationally accepted standardized test scores (e.g., SAT/ACT/A-Level/AP/IB). Academic transcript in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. * 7. Financial Support Guarantee Statement You can download a template or sample from here . * 8. Personal statement or study plan. More than 800 words in Chinese or English. * 9. Record of medical examination for foreigners Valid for 6 months from the date of issue. You can download a template or sample from here . 10. Other supporting documents. Eg.recommendation letter, certificates of awards, certificates of paper publication, etc. * 11. 3-5 minute self-introduction video The video should include the following 1. Self-introduction 2. Understanding of China 3. Study plan in China * 12. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
